govdocs-archive_org-MasonicTempleToPadre: Franco Adessa’s ‘A New Church Dedicated to St. Padre Pio — Masonic Temple?’ — with Fr. Luigi Villa — alleges Masonic symbolism in the Padre Pio shrine. The traditionalist Catholic work is controversial. The book belongs to alternative Catholic literature.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CIADowneyJohnT_: Thomas O’Toole’s Washington Post piece — Downey: A CIA Agent in From the Cold — covers John Downey’s long captivity. Downey spent decades in a Chinese prison. His release came in 1973. The story moved readers. The file belongs to the intelligence archive.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-MarksSidTheWatl: This FBI report — Dick Watley, The Watley Report — is a Bureau file. The declassified report is a primary source. The Bureau tracked countless citizens. The report may hold a clue. Researchers value such files. The file belongs to the government archive.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-NelsonJohnT_Nel: Harold Weisberg’s letter to John T. Nelson — November 23, 1970 — is a researcher’s note. Weisberg kept up a vast correspondence. The letter may hold a clue. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of correspondence.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-NoguchiThomasT_: This item — Noguchi, Thomas T. — is a National Security Internet Archive file. The file’s full context is unclear. Its subject seems to be the JFK case. Archivists value such fragments. The item is a fragment of the archive.
snowflakes-and-sunbeams-or-the-young-fur: R. M. Ballantyne, the Victorian master of boys' adventure, sends young fur traders into the frozen far north of Canada. His heroes hunt, trap, and survive blizzards while learning the ways of the wilderness and its native peoples. Based on Ballantyne's own years with the Hudson's Bay Company, the tale mixes real frontier detail with rousing adventure.
dave-dashaway-and-his-hydroplane-or-dari: Roy Rockwood sends young aviator Dave Dashaway over the Great Lakes in his hydroplane for a new round of aerial adventure. Storms, rivals, and daring rescues fill the skies above the water. Written when aviation was young, the story captures all the romance of early flight.
home-vegetable-gardening-a-complete-and-: F. F. Rockwell's complete guide shows the home gardener how to plant, tend, and harvest every common vegetable. Practical wisdom for the backyard plot, tested and true. The book that fed countless victory gardens. From seed-time to harvest, his plain directions turn beginners into confident growers.
the-nibelungenlied-translated-into-rhyme: G. H. Needler renders the Nibelungenlied — Siegfried, Kriemhild, and the fall of the Burgundians — into rhymed English verse. His faithful translation opens Germany's great epic to new readers. A labor of love and scholarship. Kriemhild's revenge and Hagen's doom ring through his stirring lines.
